Here’s a polished version:

“The trade replay issue, where ‘REPL’ is reported instead of ‘NEWM’ to TRAX for our active trades that are not archived in CMRS, was caused by RH archiving story 2323911 and is impacting the #13 fix.

The new ESP extract for #13 is sending replay messages for rebooked trades that have been updated with the original Position Trader information based on OMS trade linkages. Since these are all replay messages (`<SST_REPLAY> = ‘Y’`), RH will report them as ‘REPL’ to TRAX.

As a result, the #13 replay messages will all be rejected by TRAX because these trades have never been reported to TRAX before. In short, the #13 replayed trade messages will be rejected like other BAU replay messages, meaning the #13 changes from both ESP and RH will not achieve the intended outcome.”

A slightly more direct version:

“The issue where RH reports ‘REPL’ instead of ‘NEWM’ to TRAX for active trades that are not archived in CMRS was introduced by RH archiving story 2323911 and is now impacting the #13 fix.

For #13, the new ESP extract sends replay messages for rebooked trades updated with the original Position Trader information based on OMS trade linkages. Because these messages have `<SST_REPLAY> = ‘Y’`, RH reports them to TRAX as ‘REPL’.

However, these trades have never been reported to TRAX before, so TRAX will reject all #13 replay messages. This means the #13 replayed trade messages will be rejected in the same way as other BAU replay messages, making the #13 changes in both ESP and RH ineffective.”
